right_hand.action: angles a magnifying glass over the jar for a closer look
right_hand.grip: precision pinch on the magnifying glass handle

pose.gesture_summary: mid-observation freeze frame — close inspection of the specimen
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

accessories.placement: both hands — fingertips exposed for dexterity

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of hands examines a small tide-pool specimen jar at a research bench. The left hand holds the glass jar containing a tiny sea star up to the light while the right hand angles a magnifying glass for a closer look, a tablet beside them showing a simple fish-silhouette identification chart. The mood is gently curious field science, not a sterile lab.

primary_objects.name: magnifying glass

primary_objects.name: tide-pool tray
